title: Portfolio - Autonomous Agent
description: Capstone C -- a bounded tool-use agent. POST a signal -> Normalize Task -> Agent Loop (MIRRORS scripts/lib/agent-core.mjs: a deterministic keyword planner + refusal/allowlist/max-steps/no-fabricated guardrails, over STUB tools) -> respond with the run record (the trajectory + outcome). The agent's TOOLS are the portfolio workflows reached via the signed interaction-gateway; v0.1.0 runs the stub planner + stub tools (byte-stable trajectory), with a live LLM planner + live gateway tool execution as the opt-in next increments. The agent-core is the single source of truth (verify:agent 39/39); the Agent Loop Code node mirrors it inline, and scripts/test-agent-workflow.mjs proves the COMPILED copy (golden tasks + a DIFFERENTIAL asserting byte-identical run records vs the core). Deployed via the n8n public REST API (no MCP).

notes: v0.1.0 -- the portfolio's NINTH project and its named capstone (autonomous agent). 8 nodes (2 triggers: webhook + manual demo; 1 sticky; 4 code: normalizeTask / agentLoop / buildResponse / buildDemoTask; 1 respondToWebhook). Gates green: verify:agent (39/39 pure core: 6 golden tasks + 3 guardrail negatives) + verify:workflow (24/24: the COMPILED Agent Loop, 6 golden tasks + a differential vs the core, byte-identical run records) + verify:static + verify:json. THE CAPSTONE THESIS: the SAME scoreTrajectory rubric grades the deterministic stub planner AND a future live LLM (the 'eval a non-deterministic agent' answer A+D were built to de-risk); the agent's tools are the 6 portfolio workflows via the signed gateway. Guardrails proven as REJECTED NEGATIVES: refusal (destructive/prompt-injection -> no tool) / non-allowlisted-tool (never executed) / max-steps (bounded) / no-fabricated-result (tool failure recorded ok:false).
